body:
Source: the ADLC principle-fidelity audit (delta.md, PR #486). This ticket remediates one of the eight root-cause "seams" that audit found — cases where the toolkit trusts the model at the boundary between a built gate and the deployed system.

SEAM 4 (critical). The enforcing PreToolUse handoff hook resolves @adlc/context-handoff by walking into the PROJECT's node_modules and dynamic-imports it in a process inheriting ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY. A repo (or compromised transitive dep) shipping a package by that name wins resolution, can return {deny:false} to disable the context-rot deny-set, and can read/exfiltrate the manifest signing key. The export-presence check is a SHAPE check, not a TRUST check.

IMPORTANT PRIOR ART / DO NOT BLINDLY RE-APPLY: this exact issue was filed as #479 and fixed by commit 08c3eae ("scrub the manifest key before importing project-resolved code"), which was then REVERTED by #480 (4922c03). Before re-landing, the builder MUST investigate WHY #480 reverted the fix (read the PR discussion via 'gh pr view 480' and 'gh pr view 479') and preserve whatever legitimate flow the scrub broke. Do not reintroduce a regression.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOR
1. Scrub ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY (and any other trust-anchor secrets) from the hook process env BEFORE any project-resolved dynamic import.
2. Resolve the gate implementation only from a plugin-owned/vendored path, or a realpath verified to reside inside a trusted (non-project-writable) root; fail closed with a DISTINCT reason when resolution would land in a project-writable location.
3. Do not rely on the export-presence check as a trust boundary. Mirror the architecture the CI cross-model-gate already uses correctly (BASE code, key isolated).

Touches a rails deny-path / enforcement surface — CROSS-MODEL GATED at P5.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The hook scrubs ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY from env before any project-resolved import. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-key-scrub.test.mjs`
- A project-writable resolution of @adlc/context-handoff fails closed with a distinct reason. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-trust.test.mjs`
- The revert reason from #480 is addressed (documented in the ticket branch / PR body) and no regression is reintroduced. verify: `gh pr view 480 --json body,title` reviewed; regression case covered in `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-trust.test.mjs`
- Existing handoff-deny tests still pass. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-deny.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: Scrub ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY before project-resolved import in the handoff hook; resolve from a trusted path
